title: Check relationship candidates in their declared scope
statement: The Interpretation and validation Module shall check proposed relationship changes against the declared profile over a complete candidate scope, rejecting unknown types, unresolved endpoints, conflicting authority, invalid containment and forbidden cardinality before the proposal can be accepted.

what.problem: Relationship edits can duplicate authority, accept invalid facts or produce inconsistent endpoint observations.
what.desired_outcome: Check relationship candidates in their declared scope.

why.rationale: SR-008 requires one authoritative relationship and state-consistent forward and inverse views.

conditions: A relationship is created, replaced or removed in a selected model state.

contexts: MOD-003 within MOD-016 using IF-001 and IF-002.

how.approach: Use explicit candidate and base identities, profile-governed representation, complete scoped checks and truthful outcome reporting.

how_much.scope: The MOD-003 contribution to SR-008; other owners retain their own obligations.

acceptance_criteria: Reject unknown relationship or operation kinds before endpoint and consistency checks; do not substitute a known type or profile.
Identify missing or ambiguous endpoints and incompatible endpoint kinds using candidate-state identity findings.
Check the complete profile-required cardinality scope, including incoming facts and unchanged entities, against the resulting candidate after removals and replacements.
For parentage, check exactly one permitted parent and acyclic containment with one authoritative representation; an extra inverse or competing parent representation is invalid.
Return findings, candidate/base/profile identities and inspected scope; incomplete or unavailable input cannot produce a complete valid conclusion.
Keep relationship admission separate from whole-model conformance, authority, engineering approval and satisfaction.
constraints: Design allocation only; no implementation or verification claim.

sources.basis: Derive single-fact relationship editing, candidate admission and retention boundaries from SR-008. Proposed Design only; no runtime implementation or satisfaction claim.
